name: Cornerstone Project
description: This course is designed for M.Sc. Mathematics students to foster collaborative and interdisciplinary learning through team-based projects. Students will engage in identifying mathematical and scientific problems or themes, particularly by connecting advanced concepts from senior secondary levels (Classes XI–XII) with foundational ideas from Classes VI–X, or by developing content based on NCERT textbook activities. The course emphasizes concept mapping, the design of mathematical or experimental models, and the creation of educational resources such as demonstrations and explanatory videos. Students will also develop skills in mathematical communication, documentation, and presentation, while gaining exposure to interdisciplinary approaches in mathematics education and outreach.
